title: chenglou/handwired
why_read: A playful, educational project that turns ordinary JavaScript code into a trainable neural network, interesting for its novel framing even if not production-useful.
analysis: This project appears to let you write normal-looking JavaScript logic and then have it behave as a differentiable neural network, blurring the line between regular code and learned models. It's likely aimed at teaching or exploring how neural networks relate to standard programming constructs rather than solving a production ML problem. This kind of conceptual, exploratory tool can spark genuine insight about differentiable programming even though it's not meant for serious deployment.
